item.title: WRE News: Dolphins Release Tua Tagovailoa, Ending Six Year Era in Miami
item.description: Miami, FL - March 9, 2026 - The Miami Dolphins have officially moved on from quarterback Tua Tagovailoa, ending a six-year era that once carried franchise-altering promise. The Dolphins announced Monday that they are releasing Tagovailoa with a post–June 1 designation, closing the chapter on a tenure defined by flashes of brilliance, persistent injuries and rising questions about his long-term durability.
